label: Glass 3D — slice hero (WebGL)
description: Same as Glass 3D, but the hero shows a still slice of cake in glass: three layers (base, middle, frosting) cut as a wedge, white line edges, dotted crust, a swag line with beads and the whipped cream and cherry of Igor's 3D model (0016.obj) in glass on top. Not animated: it turns with the mouse (gyroscope on phones), a hovered layer lifts and the cream bounces. The white modules are the Glass 3D ones. Tuner: press T.
